description: Sanitized measurements copied from completed production-build captures. Per-process command lines, temporary paths and process identifiers are omitted. Outer before/after roles identify the experiment; inner candidate labels mean the supplied harness target, whose hash is recorded. Timing and forced-collection protocols remain separate. See PERFORMANCE.md for interpretation and later correctness changes.

protocol.fixture: 1000 files, 10 open tabs, 7,000-line diff, 4 C cases
protocol.memory: summed RSS and per-process macOS-attributed footprint
protocol.cpu: delta over settled samples as percent of a logical core. CPU in processes that exit between probes is excluded.
protocol.input: keypress to second renderer animation callback. Physical screen presentation is outside the measurement.

protocol.fixture: 1,000-file Git workspace, ten source tabs, 7,000-line Git diff and one approved native C sample per cycle. The first cycle also runs a 3.6-second waiting C case to observe its actual native process.
protocol.workload: Each cycle switches source/note tabs, types and undoes one edit, saves source, opens/closes Git status and a real diff, then runs/closes the approved C case.
protocol.recovery: Checkpoint deadlines start when the final test dialog closes, before native child cleanup verification. Memory is captured at the requested deadline; the following two-second sample is used for CPU. No forced GC before or during these checkpoints. Both builds use identical windows, input and cycle counts with fresh profiles.
protocol.cpu: Two-second process CPU interval following each checkpoint. Includes the sample instrumentation; exited child CPU is reported separately when available.
protocol.memory: Per-process macOS-attributed footprint and summed process RSS.
protocol.limits: Hidden-window automation and software frame callbacks do not measure physical display latency, GPU hardware utilization, laptop battery drain, or an 8 GB host.
